full_text: The page asks: 'Which type of program does this relate to?' Options include Hospice, Home Health, Durable Medical Equipment, Prescription Drug/Pharmacy (selected), Hospitals, Nursing Home/Extended Care Facility, Doctor/Ambulance Companies/Clinics, Other. Buttons: Continue, Back.
